about: kn_check sorts a change by what breaking it does to a player. A changed file takes the first tier that matches it, checked low_always, then high, then medium; anything else is low. A change takes the highest tier of its files. 'prefixes' match the start of the path from the repository root, 'names' match part of the file name (not under 'names_skip': UI only shows what the server decides). Review rules: Assets/_Game/_Docs/Guides/Review-Rules.md.

low_always.why: docs and tests cannot hurt a player

high.why: a player could lose items, Creds or a save, be locked out, or see another player's data

medium.why: a feature could stop working, but nothing is lost

needs.high: Master's /code-review at high, a second-client test, and kn_check --full once it exists
needs.low: nothing more than this check; Master's /code-review at low
